title: Renames a `purchase_details` attribute of the `Transaction` object
summary: Renames purchase_details.fuel.volume_decimal to purchase_details.fuel.quantity_decimal on the Issuing Transaction resource and related test_helper APIs.

migrationNotes.text: Renames a purchase_details attribute of the Transaction object from volume_decimal to quantity_decimal to more precisely describe the number of items purchased.

sources.quote: | [Renames a `purchase_details` attribute of the `Transaction` object](https://docs.stripe.com/changelog/2024-06-20/renames-purchase-details-transaction-object.md) | Issuing | Breaking | api |

Renames `purchase_details.fuel.volume_decimal` to `purchase_details.fuel.quantity_decimal` on the [Issuing Transaction](https://docs.stripe.com/api/issuing/transactions/object.md?api-version=2024-06-20) resource and related `test_helper` APIs.
